headline: Stealth's crouton-alpha vanishes from #9 while DeepSeek keeps the top spot
summary: The biggest story is a clean exit: stealth/crouton-alpha, last ranked #9, is gone from the board. Meanwhile DeepSeek's deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 still sits on top at 27.5% of tokens, and anthropic/claude-fable-5.2 debuts at #28.
highlights: stealth/crouton-alpha dropped off the leaderboard after last ranking #9.
openai/gpt-6.1-sol climbed five places to #9, the biggest move among the top ten.
anthropic/claude-fable-5.2 enters at #28, one of four new entrants.
DeepSeek holds 37.8% of provider share, and DeepSeek plus Tencent together account for 47.8%.
